values: 225 scenarios. Each parameterized variant needs evidence. Enter execution results in the amber cells.
Sign in separately as Super Admin, Admin, Merchant A, Merchant B and restricted staff. Open their default portal.
Each account opens its permitted portal with the correct identity. No other account data appears.
Try incorrect credentials, suspended accounts and accounts without an assigned role.
Access is denied with a safe message. No session or privilege is granted.
Use the controlled Google account already linked to a registered NUERS email. Complete the normal login flow.
Login preserves the existing user, role and merchant. No duplicate account is created.
Use a controlled Google email that is absent from the NUERS database.
Login is rejected. No NUERS account is created automatically.
In isolated tests, use an invalid state, expired handoff, reused handoff and mismatched Google subject.
Each attempt fails. An existing identity cannot be replaced or reassigned.
Refresh, deep link and browser restart
Sign in, reload a protected detail URL, open a second tab and restart the browser within the permitted session lifetime.
Session behavior follows the configured policy. No infinite loading, role switch or lost authorized destination.
Log out, use browser Back, and repeat an authenticated request with the old session. Repeat after admin revocation.
Protected data and mutations are denied after revocation. Cached sensitive data is not exposed.
Expire a session while a filter is loading and while a form has unsaved data.
Loading ends with a clear sign-in action. No silent save, request loop or exposure of old account data.
Request recovery for a test account. Test valid, expired, reused and altered tokens.
Only the valid unused token works. Existing security policy is enforced and prior sessions are handled correctly.
Change a test password using the required current credentials. Retry old password and old session/handoff.
Old credentials and invalidated sessions stop working. The new login succeeds.
Exceed the configured login limit in the lab. Supply an external return URL.
Rate limit is enforced with a recoverable message. Redirects cannot send the session to another site.
Start enrollment and enter an invalid code, then a valid code.
The device is inactive until confirmed. Invalid codes cannot enable MFA.
Add a second authenticator after the required password and existing-factor checks. Sign in with each device.
Both confirmed devices work independently. Enrolling the second does not overwrite the first secret.
Reuse an accepted code and try a code outside the permitted time window.
Replayed and expired codes are denied without bypassing MFA.
Revoke a confirmed test device and try it again. If primary, verify the remaining confirmed device.
Revoked codes stop working. Another confirmed device remains usable according to policy.
Use Account A to confirm, rename or revoke Account B device identifiers.
All cross-account device actions are denied and reveal no secret.
Cancel enrollment; start another and let it expire. Attempt confirmation afterward.
Cancelled and expired secrets cannot be activated. Active devices are not removed.
Use one recovery code, then repeat it. Test recovery under the documented procedure.
A code is consumed once. Recovery does not silently weaken privileged MFA.
Test duplicate/long device names, configured device cap and last-used metadata.
Validation is clear. No secret is returned in lists, exports, logs or browser storage.
As Merchant A, request Merchant B invoice, receipt, transaction, customer and wallet identifiers.
403/404 or scoped empty results. No B data, counts, names or amounts leak.
As A, attempt update, cancel, approve, email or delete operations using B identifiers.
Denied before mutation. B records and audit attribution remain unchanged.
Request B receipt PDF, report job download, attachment and export URLs with A session.
Every file route enforces ownership and authorization independently.
As branch-limited staff, change branch/terminal filters and direct identifiers to another branch.
Results and permitted writes stay within assigned scope. Filters cannot widen access.
As merchant and ordinary admin, call restricted endpoints directly and submit role or approval fields.
Server denies unauthorized roles and privileged fields. Hiding a button is not the only protection.
View A data, log out and log in as B in the same browser. Repeat with two concurrent tabs.
A data never flashes or persists in B views, downloads or realtime subscriptions.
Open private document, attachment, PDF, job and dashboard endpoints without credentials.
Denied. Public verification reveals only its explicitly allowed fields.
For every cookie-authenticated mutation, test missing/invalid CSRF protection. Test conflicting API credentials separately.
Unauthorized mutation fails. Authentication ambiguity cannot select a different user or merchant.
Use harmless lab payloads in names, descriptions, filters, invoice notes and filenames. Render UI, PDFs, email and CSV.
Input is escaped/validated. No script execution, query manipulation or CSV formula execution.
Try wrong MIME, oversized files, traversal names and internal-network URLs in logo/webhook fields.
Validation blocks unsupported content and unintended network/file access. Private uploads remain private.
Inspect normal/error API responses, browser storage, exported files and redacted logs.
No API secret, signing key, database credential, stack trace or encrypted raw customer payload is exposed.
Check HTTPS, redirect behavior, session cookie flags and deployed security headers against the approved configuration.
Certificate validates; cookies and headers meet the approved baseline. No mixed-content credential transfer.
Exercise documented 401/403/402/409/422/429/5xx outcomes in the lab.
Correct contract and actionable safe reason. No unauthorized sale, charge or information leak.
Perform denied access and privileged changes with test accounts. Review audit evidence.
Actor, time, action, target and outcome are attributable without logging secrets.
Submit a valid synthetic registration; repeat with missing identity, malformed TIN and duplicate account data.
Valid registration enters the intended review state. Invalid and duplicate submissions are handled clearly.
Use correct, wrong, expired and reused verification/activation links.
Only current valid proofs work. Failed verification cannot activate an account.
Choose a complete region/province/city/barangay chain; test incompatible children and unresolved RDO.
Stored address is coherent. Unresolved mapping asks for authorized manual review instead of inventing an RDO.
Upload allowed documents; download as owner/reviewer; attempt another merchant download.
Private documents retain correct ownership, type and integrity. Other merchants cannot retrieve them.
Review registration with reason/evidence. Repeat each action and try a stale revision.
Authorized transition occurs once with history. Suspension consistently restricts applicable actions.
Change contact number, website and business description from merchant profile.
Allowed fields update without identity approval. Unrelated identity fields are unchanged.
Change registered business name, TIN, address or representative through merchant workflow.
A review request is created. Current approved identity stays effective until authorized approval.
Approve an authorized representative update. Compare business profile and owner display in user directory.
Displayed representative stays aligned. Login identity and permissions do not change accidentally.
Upload a profile picture, then a different invoice logo. Refresh profile and receipt preview.
Profile image needs no identity approval. Receipt uses the separately configured invoice logo.
Open each business detail and compare wallet, transaction count/amount, fees, deposits and pending top-ups with fixtures.
Figures belong to the selected business and stated environment/period. Pending funds are not available balance.
Open Transactions from Business Details. Filter, paginate, preview a receipt and export.
Merchant scope remains fixed. Actions open the exact record and are clearly labeled without duplicate controls.
Combine name/TIN/type/status/industry/registration dates. Reset; export the result.
Counts, rows and exported scope agree. Clear empty/error states and no stale filters.
Invite controlled mailbox with a restricted role and branch. Accept once; reuse and expire the invitation.
Exactly one scoped membership is created. Expired/replayed invitations cannot grant access.
Run view/create/export/settings actions as each restricted staff role.
Only assigned capabilities work, including direct endpoint calls.
Remove a staff permission or membership while the staff tab is open; retry the action.
Revoked access stops server-side immediately according to session policy.
Search name/email; combine role, branch and status; export and paginate.
No duplicate users, missing owner or out-of-scope accounts. Export follows the filters.
Create draft and complete branch data. Test duplicate codes and attempt to change a registered immutable code.
Allowed draft behavior works; registered identity constraints and review history are preserved.
Upload private branch evidence; approve as authorized reviewer; change protected identity afterward.
Evidence is protected. A material identity change requires the documented re-review.
Assign a test terminal to an approved merchant branch. Try foreign branch, expired authority and stale revision.
Only valid scoped assignment succeeds. Invalid assignment cannot authorize transaction intake.
Suspend a branch. Submit a request or merchant claim that it is connected/BIR approved.
Applicable writes stop. API activity alone cannot establish BIR approval or verified connectivity.
Create a draft, add buyer/items, save, reopen and issue using an approved test series.
Draft persists. Issuance creates one immutable numbered document and one applicable fee debit.
Omit required seller/buyer/date/item/registration fields one at a time for each supported document type.
Clear field validation blocks invalid issuance without advancing the number or debiting wallet.
Issue using active, missing, expired, exhausted and wrong-branch series.
Only the correct active series issues within its approved range and preserves formatting.
Issue multiple documents concurrently in one branch and in separate branches.
Unique, ordered series allocation within each scope. No duplicate number or cross-branch collision.
Force failure after number reservation but before transaction commit. Retry the valid issue.
No partial financial record or charge. Transactional reservation rolls back consistently.
Void an issued test invoice and attempt to reuse its number.
Original number/history remain preserved. Reuse is rejected.
Capture valid source invoice identifiers with leading zeros/prefixes; try invalid format and duplicate identity.
Source number is printed unchanged when valid. NUERS reference remains separate; conflicts are not overwritten.
Create the same visible number under A and B. Open each from merchant, admin and PDF routes.
Lookup resolves the exact authorized merchant/document identity every time.
Try editing totals/identity after issuance. Use the supported cancel/correction workflow with evidence.
Issued financial history is preserved. Changes require the appropriate linked record and audit trail.
Issue an invoice and record its payment or supplementary document. Compare sales totals and fee ledger.
Payment copy is linked and not counted as a second sale or charged again.
Select an existing customer, add a new one and switch customers before issue.
Correct buyer data is saved. Failed/draft operations do not create unintended duplicate customers.
Preview applicable CAS and POS documents with supplied registration/branch/MIN/MSN evidence.
Applicable recorded registration fields appear correctly. Missing evidence is not fabricated.
Issue the approved fixture with one VAT-inclusive PHP 1,120 item. Compare API, UI, PDF and report.
Fixture totals: taxable base PHP 1,000; VAT PHP 120; total PHP 1,120. All views reconcile.
Run independently approved fixtures for each classification and a mixed document.
Line and document tax buckets match the approved oracle without double-taxing or relabeling sales.
Apply PHP 112 document discount to the PHP 1,120 inclusive fixture with a reason.
Manual discount PHP 112; taxable PHP 900; VAT PHP 108; total PHP 1,008. Reason persists.
Run equivalent 10% document and line discounts; also test legacy supported discount input.
Equivalent fixtures reconcile. Manual and statutory discount totals remain separately identified.
Allocate a PHP 0.01 discount over three PHP 0.01 non-VAT lines. Test fractional quantities and mixed tax lines.
Allocation is deterministic and exact to centavos; line totals sum to the immutable document total.
Use negative/over-limit discounts, conflicting input modes and a mismatched declared total.
Request is rejected before financial writes, numbering, wallet debit or email scheduling.
Run approved eligible/ineligible senior citizen fixtures with identity evidence and mixed eligible items.
Calculation, evidence, invoice labels and senior sales report match the reviewed business-rule oracle.
Run approved eligible/ineligible PWD fixtures and mixed eligible items.
Calculation, evidence and PWD report reconcile to issued documents.
Run athlete and coach fixtures with valid and missing eligibility evidence.
Applicable approved rules are used; unsupported eligibility is rejected or sent to required review.
Run approved item/scope/eligibility fixtures, including missing evidence and boundary dates.
Only supported eligible sales receive the approved treatment; solo-parent report reconciles.
Try overlapping discounts on an ineligible combination; then manual discount on a separate regular line beside a benefit line.
Unsupported overlap is rejected. Supported separate-line treatment remains distinctly recorded.
Use valid structured withholding and invalid/excess withholding. Create a supported linked CWT memo.
Gross, VAT, withholding and payable amounts reconcile. Original invoice values are not silently changed.
Use approved fixtures with service/other charges, zero charges and item-level tax classifications.
Charges are counted exactly once and displayed consistently in totals and reports.
Try zero where allowed, negative totals, maximum supported values, excess decimals and unsupported currency.
Supported PHP values use exact centavos and peso formatting. Unsupported values fail clearly.
Open View Receipt from admin transactions, recent transactions and business transaction list.
Exact merchant-branded receipt opens rather than transaction-only metadata.
Open the same document from merchant invoice/receipt lists and details.
Number, date, buyer, items, taxes and total agree with the admin view.
Inspect standard, minimal and detailed previews; generate PDFs and captured email copies.
Record Evidence, verification/QR notice and removed custom footer notes are absent. Items, tax breakdown and totals remain.
Change invoice branding and compare profile image, preview, PDF and captured email copy.
Receipt outputs use the invoice logo and configured colors. Profile image stays independent.
Use permitted image types, transparent image, missing image, invalid MIME and oversized upload.
Valid image is legible; invalid uploads fail; missing image has an intentional fallback without a broken layout.
Use many items, long descriptions, Unicode names and long addresses. Generate print/PDF.
No clipped columns, missing lines or overlaps. Pagination and totals remain readable.
Download through admin and merchant authenticated routes; inspect type and contents; compare record afterward.
Valid PDF for the requested document. Viewing/downloading does not change original financial data.
Use browser print and PDF print at supported paper sizes.
Only intended document content prints with usable margins, peso symbol and complete totals.
In lab, make PDF service unavailable or exceed a supported limit. Retry after recovery.
Clear bounded error; no endless loading, duplicate sale or lost record.
Use expired session, foreign receipt ID and unsafe text/URL content in a test receipt.
Access is denied or content is safely rendered; renderer cannot fetch arbitrary private resources.
POST a valid source-capture sale using the active scoped key. Read its status and both dashboards.
One accepted source record with stable identifiers, correct totals and one applicable fee.
Test missing, invalid, expired, revoked and wrong-scope API keys plus IP restriction mismatch.
Request fails with the documented safe status/reason and no sale or wallet change.
Put another merchant ID, source profile or branch in a request authenticated with A key.
Server derives ownership from authorized key/scope and rejects mismatches.
Submit the same event/request identity and identical payload repeatedly.
One sale and one fee only. Retry returns the existing outcome and identifiers.
Reuse an accepted identity with a different amount, discount, buyer or source content.
Conflict is returned. Original record and wallet remain unchanged.
Send the same valid event concurrently from multiple workers.
Exactly one acceptance, fee and customer-email request. Other outcomes are documented retries/conflicts.
In lab, drop the client response after successful commit. Retry with the same identity.
Original acceptance is recovered without a duplicate sale or debit.
Submit a valid batch, then a batch with one invalid event and one exceeding total wallet funding.
Valid batch follows contract. Rejected atomic batch leaves no partial sales, fees, sequence or mail jobs.
Test max payload/batch/item limits, malformed JSON, wrong content type and unknown required schema version.
Limits and errors match the documented contract without memory exhaustion or partial writes.
Use separate keys and try environment overrides. Inspect dashboard, wallet, export and email behavior.
Sandbox stays distinct; it does not debit Live wallet, send real customer email or increase Live sales.
Try active, expired, wrong-merchant and incomplete source profiles.
Required source review and registration controls are enforced consistently without forged authority.
In a test ERP/POS/ecommerce, show successful, validation-failed, insufficient-wallet, throttled and uncertain requests.
Each sale shows NUERS Success or Error with actionable reason, reference and safe retry behavior.
BIR status omitted from merchant intake contract
Inspect current and supported legacy intake/status responses and integration documentation.
No deprecated BIR Not_verified field is presented as the NUERS transaction outcome.
Read accepted/failed event status with right and foreign keys; page large result sets.
Stable bounded responses, correct scope and no payload/credential leakage.
Send authenticated invalid payload, insufficient-wallet request and rate-limited request. Open admin failed attempts.
Received failure appears with merchant, environment, time and safe reason; it is not counted as an accepted sale.
Disconnect the test integration before transmission. Inspect integration outbox and NUERS dashboard.
Integration shows pending/error locally. NUERS does not invent a received transaction it never observed.
Send fixed and percentage manual discounts through the API, then compare receipt, admin list, report and export.
Discount amounts, reasons and totals persist unchanged across every representation.
Run valid and invalid examples from website and downloadable API guide against staging.
Published request fields, status codes, errors and examples match current behavior and declared version.
Finalize a valid Live-mode test sale with a controlled customer email using the staging mail sink.
One receipt-delivery job for that recipient with the correct merchant document and branding.
Submit without email, then with malformed email.
Absent email does not schedule mail. Invalid email follows the documented validation result with no partial financial write.
Retry an accepted emailed sale; reject an atomic batch after validation.
Retry does not resend automatically; rolled-back batch schedules no receipt mail.
Simulate rejection, timeout and ambiguous SMTP completion. Check sale outcome and delivery history.
Sale is not reversed/repeated. Delivery has an accurate retryable/uncertain state and bounded retries.
As authorized merchant, resend to a controlled approved recipient. Attempt foreign-document resend.
Authorized send is audited with correct attachment. Foreign or unauthorized resend is denied.
Trigger low balance, profile review and transaction-related notifications for A. Sign in as B.
Only intended recipients see notifications; read/unread state and links resolve correctly.
Change supported preferences; test admin SMTP save/test and non-admin access.
Preferences apply per user. Secrets stay masked and unauthorized configuration is denied.
Send to the controlled HTTPS receiver. Verify signature and event identity using documented example code.
Receiver can authenticate the exact payload; event maps to the correct tenant and environment.
Replay a delivery; return 5xx/timeout; process out-of-order deliveries.
Receiver deduplicates; NUERS retries within policy and preserves delivery evidence without duplicate sales.
Attempt private-network/loopback target, redirect and another merchant webhook configuration.
Unsafe or unauthorized destinations are rejected. Secrets are not disclosed.
Zero minimum charges every eligible sale
Set test fee PHP 3 and minimum PHP 0. Accept five distinct finalized eligible Live-mode sales.
Total NUERS charges PHP 15. No amount exemption applies to valid eligible sales.
Set minimum PHP 500 and fee PHP 3. Submit valid amounts PHP 499.99, 500.00 and 500.01.
Below minimum is uncharged; at/above minimum charged once each. Admin configuration is authoritative.
Change fee/minimum as Super Admin; try as merchant/ordinary unauthorized role. Reopen earlier debits.
Only authorized pricing changes work. Historical fees retain their original rate/revision.
Use PHP 3 balance for a PHP 3 fee; then PHP 2.99. Repeat through API and portal.
Exact funding succeeds once. Insufficient balance rejects without sale, sequence consumption or negative balance.
Start several paid issues simultaneously with funds sufficient for only some.
Successful commits reconcile to available funds; no overdraft, duplicate fee or partial accepted record.
Save draft, publish once, then create supported payment copy/adjustment and retry it.
Funding check follows policy; actual fee is once per eligible finalized sale, without duplicate charging.
Compare dashboard Available Wallet card with Wallet page and posted ledger. Open Top-Up.
Same available amount with peso currency; button opens the correct funding workflow.
Request top-up with required method/reference/evidence. Re-submit same request.
One pending request; available balance is unchanged until approved credit.
Review a request as authorized independent reviewer; test self-approval and repeated approval.
Policy is enforced. Exactly one posted credit; requester cannot bypass independent review.
Reject/cancel a pending request with reason; retry approval afterward.
No credited funds. Final state and review history are consistent.
Exercise permitted withdrawal/adjustment with evidence, then tampered or duplicate identifiers in the lab.
Ledger stays balanced, immutable and attributable; unsupported debit/credit is denied.
Filter date/type/status; page and export wallet entries. Compare opening + credits - debits = closing.
Statement and displayed balances reconcile in centavos for the same scope.
Set permitted threshold; cross it using test transactions; replenish and cross again.
Correct targeted notices and current balance; no alert storm or cross-merchant notification.
Compare total available wallet, credited deposits, fees, withdrawals and pending requests against two-merchant fixture.
Each metric uses its labeled basis. Pending deposits and Sandbox sales are excluded from posted Live balances.
Create a fixture with issued, failed, pending, cancelled and supplementary records. Compare admin and merchant metrics.
Counts and amounts use documented definitions; payment copies and failed attempts are not double-counted as sales.
Check transaction amount, NUERS charged, merchant wallet, deposits and Registered Merchants.
All widgets match independent fixture totals, correct labels, period and peso formatting.
Compare daily sales, issued invoices, transactions, failures and wallet with merchant source data.
Only that merchant and the stated PHT period are included.
Create new activity, then inspect flow, distribution, region and connection tables.
Charts and timestamps reflect observed activity. Historical rows are not replayed as current traffic.
Use records at 23:59:59 and 00:00:00 PHT, prior days and future times.
Correct PHT date boundaries; future and unrelated historical records do not inflate Today.
Open active tables/widgets and observe network calls while adding a fixture record.
Revision refresh runs at the configured one-second cadence without overlapping full scans. Changed data appears within agreed freshness target.
While data updates, change page/filter/sort, scroll, select rows and type into an unsaved form.
Updates preserve context and edits; stale responses cannot replace newer results.
Background/resume tabs; simulate slow API, offline state and 429.
Polling backs off/pauses appropriately, indicates stale/error state and recovers without request storms.
Show unconfigured BIR and planned server states alongside actual NUERS activity.
No fake BIR success, production acknowledgment or online server claim is derived from local data availability.
Search business name, formatted/unformatted TIN, invoice number and transaction reference; include Unicode.
Expected matches only; no stale query or excessive data return.
Combine date, merchant, branch, document type, status, payment method, category, tax class, amount and environment where offered.
Rows and counts satisfy every selected condition. Reset clears all applied state.
Test inclusive date endpoints, missing endpoints, reversed range, amount zero and min greater than max.
Valid boundaries work; invalid combinations show clear validation and do not silently broaden results.
Use first/last/deep pages and each supported sort with duplicate dates/amounts. Change page size.
Stable tie-breaking prevents unexplained duplicates/skips; row numbering and counts are consistent.
Select page rows, change filters and invoke supported bulk action preview.
Selected scope is explicit; old hidden selections cannot affect unintended companies/records.
Use Details, View Receipt, PDF and overflow actions with mouse, keyboard and narrow screen.
Clear labels/tooltips, correct target, no duplicated Details link, clipped menu or accidental action.
Query no results; return an error/timeout; retry successfully.
Loading always resolves into data, empty or actionable error. No permanent spinner.
Apply filters, open detail, use Back/Forward, then reload a supported deep link.
Navigation preserves expected state and correct scope without requesting the entire dataset.
Run daily, monthly, business, type, payment and branch summaries against approved fixture totals.
Sales, transaction counts, taxable base and VAT reconcile; excluded/invalid evidence is disclosed.
Run date/branch/type/category filters and each displayed breakdown.
Only owned records; totals match source fixtures and admin totals for the same scope.
Generate separate senior citizen, PWD, national athlete/coach and solo-parent reports.
Category, discount, VAT and sales amounts reconcile with the reviewed fixtures; reports are not mislabeled as official submissions.
Run transaction, wallet/deposit/fee, failed-attempt, audit, user, registry, PTI and infrastructure reports offered by the UI.
Each advertised report either produces accurate output or clearly states its unmet dependency. No decorative dead actions.
Every Export control supports its promised formats
Inventory all export controls on Page Inventory; generate PDF and CSV for each supported report/list.
Working PDF/CSV actions with meaningful filenames, actual file types and explicit scope. Missing promised format is logged as a defect.
Filter a dataset, select a merchant/environment and export. Compare row count and totals with the complete matching result.
Export uses the same authorized filters, not just the visible page unless explicitly chosen. No foreign records.
Inspect cover/header, NUERS official logo/colors, report title, date/time PHT, filters, merchant identity, totals, columns and page numbers.
Readable complete details, repeated table headers where needed, no clipping and correct branding.
Export leading-zero identifiers, peso amounts, Unicode, commas/quotes/newlines and formula-like text.
Rows parse correctly, identifiers retain meaning, numbers reconcile and spreadsheet formula injection is neutralized.
Request a large filtered export; observe queued/running/completed/failed states; download as owner.
Bounded background processing, useful progress/status, authorized download and clear limits without silent truncation.
Export while new sales arrive. Compare recorded scope/cutoff and totals.
Output uses a coherent documented cutoff and does not contain duplicate/missing rows caused by pagination races.
Interrupt a worker, retry according to workflow, then access an expired or foreign download link.
No duplicate uncontrolled jobs; failed/expired state is clear; unauthorized downloads are denied.
Print representative short/long reports and every distinct report template.
All columns/totals remain legible; print output has no UI controls, blank filler pages or cut-off text.
Create merchant PTI draft, fill required evidence, submit for internal review and export the package.
Scoped preparation workflow works. Preparing/submitting internally does not claim BIR issued a permit.
Request corrections, resubmit, record filing reference and attach issued-authority evidence in a test workflow.
Status transitions require evidence/reason, revisions and authorized reviewers; exactly one linked authority when appropriate.
Attempt foreign application read/update/download; alter a test attachment or submit stale revision.
Access/integrity/revision failures stop the operation without changing the accepted record.
Record separate synthetic permits/registration for branch/system/environment; test wrong scope and expired dates.
One type of authority never automatically grants another. Applicable scope and dates are enforced.
Record approved solution/version/configuration evidence and test expiry or material version change.
Readiness follows verified evidence and approved scope; uploaded files alone cannot establish accreditation.
Test continuity mode and then enforcement mode in isolated configuration. Retry an already accepted event.
Current authorized continuity behavior remains intact; enforced mode blocks new ineligible intake without corrupting prior records/retries.
Record a test outage, manual document and restored-service evidence; create one replacement with matching identity.
Manual record remains linked; recovery replacement is scoped, traceable and not duplicated or double-charged.
Create a valid memo linked to an owned issued invoice; try foreign original or conflicting draft.
Original financial data stays immutable. Scope and competing-revision checks are enforced.
Generate a statement for eligible fee entries; repeat the same claim and try missing issuer identity.
Entries are claimed once with correct issuer/details and no additional wallet charge.
Attempt ordinary edit/delete of protected records. In lab modify/tail-delete audit evidence and verify integrity.
Protected history remains retained; tampering is detected and cannot be silently marked verified.
Compare UI labels, downloadable guides and current workflow capabilities.
Unconfigured transport, internal preparation and official acceptance are distinguished. No unsupported certification claim.
Open candidate documents separately from transmission attempts; filter by company, branch, dates, status and environment.
Eligible stored transactions are discoverable even with no submission attempt. Candidate and transmission counts remain distinct.
Prepare selected owned documents or a filtered company batch; inspect final mapped count and payload.
Company/branch/environment scope is retained, required source checks run, and limits apply after any tax-class split.
Prepare same request twice; change payload under same request identity; cancel a never-sent batch.
No duplicate batch claim; changed payload conflicts; cancellation preserves audit history.
Keep outbound disabled, configure synthetic connection and try authentication, release and worker execution.
No external request is sent; UI explains the missing gate and no document is marked BIR accepted.
Save synthetic credential bundle and inspect API/list/export/logs with multiple roles.
Secrets are encrypted and never returned; privileged configuration requires authorized MFA.
Run maintained CAS/POS fixtures for IDs, signatures, precision, tax classes, correction references and response parsing.
Outputs match the selected documented dialect and immutable source totals. Unsupported/inconsistent input is blocked.
Fake a timeout after potential send, then return inquiry results using the same Submit ID.
No second invoice POST. State stays uncertain until authenticated per-invoice evidence resolves it.
Fake partial success, duplicate result, missing/extra UID, wrong identity and unknown response code.
No false full acceptance. Exact expected identities/counts are checked and exceptions remain reviewable.
Prepare a valid test batch, then expire/revoke permit, key or profile before release.
New send is blocked by current gates. Safe inquiry of prior sends remains independently controlled.
With fakes, test bad signature, replay and wrong tenant/environment callback.
Callback cannot directly declare acceptance; certification never increases production acceptance totals.
When credentials arrive, confirm official endpoint/version/dialect and run prescribed certification authentication.
Actual issued credentials interoperate with the confirmed contract; retain real certification evidence.
Run the BIR-prescribed positive/negative and representative CAS/POS scenarios after authorized setup.
Each required official scenario has actual evidence and resolved discrepancies; lab passes are not substituted.
After authority/certification approval, test controlled production release, inquiry and reconciliation under the approved plan.
Authentic complete per-invoice acceptance is recorded; remaining activation gates are signed off.
Inspect grid/table, all server tabs, search/filter and responsive details.
Readable controls and metrics; planned/unconfigured nodes are labeled accurately with no fabricated telemetry.
Try server/backup settings and actions as anonymous, merchant and unauthorized admin.
Denied before dispatch, including direct endpoints and exports.
With controller disabled, try reboot/shutdown/service action review using a test inventory.
No command runs. Missing prerequisites are clearly shown.
With fake controller, test step-up expiry, replay, self-approval, changed revision and unsafe peer/quorum conditions.
Unsafe or unauthorized action is blocked. Dispatch rechecks current conditions.
Use fake controller to test duplicate action IDs, invalid service/command/target and ambiguous response.
Only allowlisted actions dispatch once. Ambiguous outcomes stay locked for reconciliation.
Inject fresh, stale, repeated and wrong-identity synthetic telemetry.
Only valid fresh telemetry updates live status. Old samples do not extend freshness.
Create encrypted lab backup; verify checksum; try wrong key, truncated archive and altered bytes.
Valid archive verifies; corruption/wrong key fail closed. Credentials remain separately controlled.
Restore lab backup to empty isolated targets; compare counts, balances, documents, attachments and sequences.
Data reconciles to the backup snapshot. Restore cannot overwrite unintended paths/targets.
Record incident time, latest recoverable committed timestamp, restore start and service validation finish.
RTO = incident to validated recovery; RPO = incident minus latest recovered committed data time. Report actual lab results and workload.
After storage is provisioned, test separate custody, restore access and controlled production-equivalent recovery.
Real evidence meets approved recovery targets. Planned providers/regions are not reported as already deployed.
When agents/controller/HA are provisioned, execute approved isolated service/failover/quorum/network recovery drills.
Actual identity, mTLS, locking, rollback and postchecks succeed with documented evidence.
Simulate stale worker, storage pressure, failed backup, certificate expiry and unavailable dependency in lab.
Correct actionable alerts and runbooks; no false healthy state or lost queued work.
Export one synthetic merchant package, verify manifest/hashes and restore/import into an isolated target.
Complete authorized data is usable and reconciled, including attachments and references, with no other tenant data.
Run first page, filters and deep pagination over 1 million total rows and separately 1 million rows for one merchant.
Approved p95/p99 targets met with bounded page payloads; no full dataset sent to browser or tenant leakage.
Summary List of Sales at scale
Run daily/monthly/merchant breakdowns over large and skewed datasets with cold and warm caches.
Correct totals and bounded queries; loading resolves within agreed target without timeouts.
Apply the performance protocol to each Page Inventory route and its largest table/widget.
First useful content and API timings recorded per page; slow pages are filed as defects, not hidden in averages.
Ramp approved concurrent users while accepting idempotent transactions and reading dashboards/exports.
No overspend/duplicate records/deadlocks escaping recovery; latency/error targets remain within agreed limits.
Open multiple merchant/admin tabs under load; measure revision checks, full queries and DB/worker usage.
No overlapping scans or default 429 storm. Freshness target met while server resource limits remain stable.
Export 100k and 1 million matching rows where supported, while ordinary pages remain in use.
Background/streamed processing stays bounded; explicit limits are disclosed; ordinary pages remain responsive.
Cold start and index/query plan review
Restart only lab components; test common and worst-case search patterns; capture plans and query counts.
No unbounded hydration/N+1 loops; supported query plans meet agreed performance targets.
Throttle test network; disconnect during read and queued write; restore connectivity.
Bounded errors and recovery; local outbox retains identity without duplicate sales or cross-account replay.
Kill lab worker during job and simulate dependency loss before/after commit. Recover and reconcile.
Durable work resumes safely with no lost committed record, duplicate fee or blind BIR resubmission.
Run agreed mixed workload for 2 hours or the approved duration. Track CPU, memory, connections, queues and browser heap.
No unbounded growth or degrading latency; final counts/balances reconcile.
Give one merchant 95% of data/traffic; concurrently use a small merchant.
One tenant cannot exhaust shared capacity or cause another tenant to receive wrong/stale data.
Apply controlled throttling and transient errors; observe clients and return service to normal.
Clients honor retry policy without tight loops; recover automatically and preserve clear state.
For every Page Inventory entry, open via menu and direct URL, then reload and use Back/Forward.
Correct page/redirect and title. No blank screen, infinite loader or broken navigation.
For each route, test allowed and disallowed roles plus ownership/branch restrictions on actual data requests.
Server-side access matches approved RBAC, regardless of route wrapper or hidden menus.
Exercise every tab, primary button, modal, cancel/back, submit, validation and error path.
No dead controls, accidental double submission, inaccessible dialog or lost unsaved work without notice.
Check 390px, tablet, desktop, 200% zoom, keyboard focus, labels, contrast and screen-reader names.
Readable standard fonts, usable actions and meaningful focus. No hidden required controls or unusable clipping.
Check first load, zero data, high volume, slow/offline network, session expiry and recovery.
Each state is distinct and actionable; no fake zero totals or stale success.
Inspect login, public pages, portals, loading screen, browser icon and documentation links.
Official global logo/favicon/loading animation and declared version appear consistently with legible fonts.
List every export/print control found on the route and execute the applicable REP test cases.
Every advertised action works with correct filters, ownership and output details.
Record console errors, failed requests, useful-content time and slow API responses for each route.
No unhandled errors or repetitive failures. Results meet approved targets and evidence is attached.
Create/update a test customer; validate duplicate fields, search, filters, details and export.
Correct owned customer records with validation and stable paging; issued invoice history is preserved.
Use supported client/consumer/verification flows with owned and unrelated receipt identities.
Only permitted customer data is disclosed; guessing a number does not expose full private records.
Create a test support request, reply as permitted support account and mark read/update status.
Messages stay in the correct conversation/account with accurate unread state and attachments policy.
Attempt another merchant conversation/message/notification ID and links after logout.
Unauthorized access is denied without leaking private content.
For enabled BIR/RDO/client/consumer/API portals, run common page checks and approved role-specific use cases.
Only explicitly approved scope is visible. Unsupported functionality is clearly identified, not shown as completed.
Open website/merchant documentation links and download each advertised guide/report/manual.
Files open, have correct name/version/branding, and match the current published capabilities.
Use global search and Help from each portal; open a permitted result and an inaccessible target.
Search is role/tenant scoped. Help routes and deep links work without exposing private content.
On the exact release candidate run login, scoped sale, fee, receipt PDF, report export, retry and logout. Record build/hash.
Critical smoke cases pass with evidence; no acceptance conclusion is based solely on earlier test runs.

Unique/replayed/conflicting event IDs, key scopes/environments, malformed payload, atomic batch and dropped response.

Maintained protocol fixtures, fake auth/inquiry, 1/100/over-limit mapped invoices, partial/unknown/duplicate responses.

Planned nodes; fake controller; fresh/stale telemetry; unsafe peer/quorum; independent test reviewers.
Do not reboot/shutdown production to run this checklist.

Record lab RTO/RPO. Production claims require a separate real approved recovery exercise.
Run 1M total rows across merchants and separately 1M in one tenant; skew 95% toward hot tenant; mixed reads/writes/exports.

Synthetic customer/client records, private support conversations, unread notifications and public document links.
Give each tenant recognizably different fixture data to detect leaks.
p95 ≤ 2 s; p99 ≤ 5 s on supported indexed filters.
Measure at the agreed concurrency with 1M rows, warm/cold caches and realistic selectivity. Proposed target, not an existing SLA.
p95 ≤ 3 s on the agreed desktop/network profile.
Measure rows/widgets becoming usable, not just HTML response. Track slow devices separately.
Configured revision check around 1 s; changed data visible p95 ≤ 5 s after commit.
Keep one coordinated refresh loop; no overlapping heavy queries or unexpected 429 storm. Record browser background behavior.
0 tenant leaks, 0 duplicate accepted sales/fees, 0 unexplained balance or total mismatch.
Expected validation/permission rejections are not service failures. Reconcile after every load/recovery run.
Unexpected 5xx/timeouts < 0.1% during the agreed steady-state run.
Separate scheduled fault injection and expected throttling. Log absolute request counts and each failure reason.
Ramp 1, 10, 50, 100 concurrent users; higher load only against an agreed capacity plan.
Run for 15 minutes per stage, then 2-hour soak. Capture p50/p95/p99, throughput, CPU/RAM, DB plans/locks and queue lag.
Agree size/job completion and RTO/RPO targets before execution; record actual results.
No invented production recovery result. Large PDFs may have explicit supported limits; no silent truncation.
QA lead: ______   Ops lead: ______   Approved targets/date: ______
Write the exact environment, hardware, build, data volume, scenario mix and target deviations in execution evidence.
No system QA execution is claimed by this workbook. All cases/routes start Not Run. Existing automated tests are supporting coverage, not current results.
Run functional mutations on staging with synthetic data. Run performance, fault injection and recovery in an isolated environment. Live smoke is read-only unless separately authorized.
1. Login and tenant isolation  2. Invoice/API/wallet smoke  3. Full functional cases  4. All page routes/exports  5. Security/load/recovery  6. Defect retest and regression.
P0: security, ownership, financial correctness, immutable records or release-critical control. P1: core usability, reporting and operational behavior. Run P0 first.

For each variant record Result, Actual result, Evidence, Tester, Tested on, Build and Environment. Evidence should include request/response or screenshot plus relevant record IDs, with secrets redacted.

Not Run: no execution. In Progress: underway. Pass: expected result met with evidence. Fail: mismatch. Blocked: unmet prerequisite. Deferred: approved later scope. N/A: documented reason and QA approval.
Run PAGE-001 to PAGE-008 on every route and each nested tab/modal. Substitute actual authorized IDs for URL parameters. Declared route access is not proof of server authorization.
BIR-issued credentials/authorization and unprovisioned infrastructure are separate gated cases. Use Blocked/Deferred with owner and prerequisite; do not mark Pass based on a mock.
Current shared receipt omits the removed Record Evidence / verification / custom footer section. Preserve merchant logo, invoice identity, line items, financial totals and tax breakdown.
Test both 1M platform rows and 1M rows for one merchant. Proposed targets are on Test Data; QA/Ops must confirm them for the exact environment before measurement.
Identified release/build; isolated environment and mail sink; approved account matrix, fixtures/oracles and credentials; stable dependency setup; recovery path for test data.
All in-scope P0/P1 cases and page checks passed with evidence; no open critical/high security or financial defects; fixes retested; scope exceptions and external gates explicitly signed off.
S1: data leak/loss, unauthorized access or widespread outage. S2: wrong financial result, blocked core flow or major control failure. S3: limited function defect. S4: minor visual/text issue.
